# Huberman Lab

> Science-based health and neuroscience podcast by Stanford neuroscientist Dr. Andrew Huberman offering evidence-backed protocols, expert interviews, and tools for optimizing physical and mental performance.

Huberman Lab is a leading science communication platform with over 1 million newsletter subscribers, featuring Dr. Andrew Huberman's research-driven approach to health optimization. The site provides comprehensive resources including a full podcast archive, interactive topic guides, exclusive premium content, and a published protocols book.

## Key Topics

- Neuroscience
- Health Optimization
- Nervous System
- Neuroplasticity
- Health Protocols
- Goal-Setting and Habits
- Mental Health
- Sleep and NSDR
- Fitness Science
- Wellness
- Expert Interviews
- Science-Based Tools
- Dr. Andrew Huberman
- Dopamine
- Brain Health

## Core Resources

- [Huberman Lab](https://www.hubermanlab.com): Homepage for Dr. Andrew Huberman's health podcast with science-based protocols and tools.
- [Podcast - Huberman Lab](https://www.hubermanlab.com/podcast): Main podcast hub featuring Dr. Huberman's science-based health and wellness episodes.
- [Protocols: An Operating Manual for the Human Body](https://www.hubermanlab.com/protocols-book): Dr. Huberman's first book offering science-backed tools for physical and mental health.
- [Neural Network Newsletter - Huberman Lab](https://www.hubermanlab.com/newsletter): Email newsletter signup for 1M+ subscribers receiving science-based health protocols.
- [About Andrew Huberman - Huberman Lab](https://www.hubermanlab.com/about): Biography of Stanford neuroscientist Dr. Andrew Huberman and his credentials.

## Health & Science Topics

- [Topics - Huberman Lab](https://www.hubermanlab.com/topics): Searchable index of 20+ health and neuroscience topics covered on Huberman Lab.
- [The Brain and Neuroplasticity - Huberman Lab](https://www.hubermanlab.com/topics/brain-and-neuroplasticity): Science of neuroplasticity, habit formation, and brain's adaptive potential.
- [Achieving Goals and Building Habits - Huberman Lab](https://www.hubermanlab.com/topics/goals-and-habits): Science guide on goal-setting and habit formation involving dopamine and brain circuits.
- [Mental Health - Huberman Lab](https://www.hubermanlab.com/topics/mental-health): Comprehensive guide to mental health conditions and science-based treatments.
- [Fitness and Workout Routines - Huberman Lab](https://www.hubermanlab.com/topics/fitness-and-workout-routines): Evidence-based fitness science for personalized training and recovery protocols.
- [Happiness and Wellbeing - Huberman Lab](https://www.hubermanlab.com/topics/happiness-and-wellbeing): Science of well-being covering resilience, stress management, and growth mindset.
- [General Health - Huberman Lab](https://www.hubermanlab.com/topics/general-health): Overview of neurobiology and physiology connecting brain and body systems.

## Specialized Protocols

- [Non-Sleep Deep Rest (NSDR) - Huberman Lab](https://www.hubermanlab.com/nsdr): Science-based guide to NSDR and Yoga Nidra for sleep and stress relief.
